entities.summary: Vladimir Vasilyevich Bulgakov is a Russian retired colonel general. He last served as the commander of the Far Eastern Military District from 2006 to 2009, and previously as the Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Ground Forces from 2003 to 2006. His last promotion was to colonel general in 2001 and was awarded the title Hero of the Russian Federation in 2000.
